title: Accept commands written as list items
pr_body: Reviewers write checklists like `- @pullbeacon review`. Strip a leading list marker before matching commands.

bugs.anchor: if fence is not None or line.startswith(">"):
bugs.title: Indented block quotes are no longer ignored
bugs.rationale: Changing lstrip().startswith('>') to startswith('>') means a quoted command indented by spaces (e.g. '  > @pullbeacon apply' when replying to someone) is executed, contradicting the module contract that quoted commands never trigger.

traps.rationale: Stripping one list marker keeps the indentation and is the intended feature.

author: claude
